latHint: Think a group of experts - not a snowboard.
pivHint: You ride a BOARD down the slope - but a BOARD of directors is a ______ of leaders.
winText: Round table. BOARD was the pivot - a snowboard to a PANEL of directors.
lossText: PANEL - a group who advise or decide. BOARD was the pivot: snow BOARD to a BOARD of directors.
